findings.title: MULTI_ENTRY report sample stringification
findings.description: getFormReport has no explicit MULTI_ENTRY branch, so it falls through to the generic text bucket where String(answer) on a string[] produces a comma-joined string like 'Alice,Bob' as a single sample entry rather than two separate rows. The answered/skipped counters are correct (isAnswered handles non-empty arrays properly), but the per-entry breakdown in the Reports UI is lost. Fix: add an explicit MULTI_ENTRY branch before the text fallthrough that flatMaps the arrays into individual strings. One-liner: `const sample = answers.flatMap(a => Array.isArray(a) ? a : [String(a)]).filter(s => typeof s === 'string' && s.trim() !== '').slice(0, 20);`
